- Build a complete, playable top-down hide-and-seek game in a facility where the player hides from a Beast and nine bot players.

## Requirements
- Include a lab starting point, connecting corridors, a movement-slowing freezer, real-time control-room camera monitors, railway with passing trains, core elevator floors 1–5, and dark connecting vents.
- Provide run, crouch, flashlight, and whistle controls.
- Make the player hide from the Beast alongside nine bot players.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Implement as a standalone HTML/CSS/JavaScript canvas game with no external game engine.
- Use keyboard and mobile touch controls, a three-minute survival objective, and a facility map overlay.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created game interface and styling in `index.html` and `style.css`.
- Began implementing facility layout, player/bot/Beast behavior, controls, cameras, elevator, and rendering in `game.js`.

### Active
- Finish `game.js`; the latest write ended after the `start()` function and the IIFE/script is incomplete.
- Validate and play-test the game after completing the implementation.

### Blocked
- `node --check game.js` previously reported `SyntaxError: Unexpected token '}'`; that version was replaced, but the latest incomplete file has not been syntax-checked.

## Next Move
1. Complete `game.js` with rendering, minimap, feed and elevator UI setup, input bindings, and animation loops; close the IIFE.
2. Run `node --check game.js` and correct errors.
3. Launch the game and test gameplay and responsive controls in a browser; save and inspect a current screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, HUD, overlays, buttons, and canvases.
- `style.css`: Game visuals and responsive layout.
- `game.js`: Gameplay and rendering implementation; incomplete.
- `README.md`: Project landing page; no game-specific updates.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The latest `game.js` includes area/pathing/player/bot/Beast logic and `start()`, but currently lacks the rest of the script, including render setup and closing wrapper.
